create_implicitron_model_factory: create an ImplicitronModelFactory instance to initialize an implicit rendering model with configurable resume behavior
resume_model_from_checkpoint: resume a PyTorch3D implicit rendering model from a checkpoint in the experiment directory
resume_model_from_epoch: resume a model from a specific training epoch using the resume_epoch parameter
force_resume_model: force resume a model from checkpoint and raise FileNotFoundError if no checkpoint exists
load_model_state_dict: load a model's state dictionary from a checkpoint file with strict or non-strict mode fallback
